user.description: Please enter your API token from your [Todoist Settings page]({settings_url})

zone_radius_invalid.message: Zone "{zone}" has a radius of {radius} meters, but Todoist location reminders need a radius between 1 and {max_radius} meters

new_task.description: Creates a new task and adds it to a project.

assignee.description: The username of a shared project's member to assign this task to.
assignee.name: Assignee

due_date.description: The time this task is due, in format YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, in UTC timezone.
due_date.name: Due date

due_date_string.description: The time this task is due, in natural language.
due_date_string.name: Due date string

labels.description: Any labels that you want to apply to this task, separated by a comma.
labels.name: Labels

priority.description: The priority of this task, from 1 (normal) to 4 (urgent).
priority.name: Priority

project.description: The name of the project this task should belong to.
project.name: Project

reminder_date.description: When the user should be reminded of this task, in format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, in UTC timezone.
reminder_date.name: Reminder date

reminder_date_string.description: When the user should be reminded of this task, in natural language.
reminder_date_string.name: Reminder date string

reminder_latitude.description: The latitude of the location that should trigger the reminder. Note that this location is shared with Todoist.
reminder_latitude.name: Reminder latitude

reminder_location_direction.description: Whether the reminder should be triggered when entering or leaving the location.
reminder_location_direction.name: Reminder location direction

reminder_location_name.description: An alias name for the location that should trigger the reminder.
reminder_location_name.name: Reminder location name

reminder_longitude.description: The longitude of the location that should trigger the reminder. Note that this location is shared with Todoist.
reminder_longitude.name: Reminder longitude

reminder_radius.description: The radius, in meters, around the location that should trigger the reminder.
reminder_radius.name: Reminder radius

reminder_zone.description: The zone that should trigger the reminder. Note that the zone's location is shared with Todoist.
reminder_zone.name: Reminder zone

section.description: The name of a section within the project to add the task to.
section.name: Section

new_task.name: Create task
